rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Art Nouveau
rows.Origin:
Bred by Peter J. James (United Kingdom, before 2009).
Introduced in New Zealand by Tasman Bay Roses / Cornerstone Roses in circa 2013 as 'Art Nouveau'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, white streaks, stripes, flecks. None to mild fragrance. Semi-double (9-16 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 2' to 30" (60 to 75cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or garden. Very hardy. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
